title: 左右平移得到同一块
Left and right translates agree
text: 正规子群在所有共轭下不变：gNg⁻¹=N。交换群的每个子群都正规；非交换群则需额外检验。
A normal subgroup is invariant under every conjugation: gNg⁻¹=N. Every subgroup of an abelian group is normal; nonabelian groups require an additional check.
example: D₃ 中旋转子群 ⟨r⟩ 正规，反射子群 ⟨s⟩ 不正规。改变所选 g，观察左右陪集何时不同。
In D₃, the rotation subgroup ⟨r⟩ is normal, but the reflection subgroup ⟨s⟩ is not. Compare left and right cosets.

title: 等价判别与指数 2
Equivalent tests and index two
text: N≤G 时，对每个 g∈G、n∈N 检查 gng⁻¹∈N 就够了。另一个常用捷径：指数为 2 的子群一定正规。
For a subgroup N, it suffices to check gng⁻¹∈N for all g,n. A useful special case: every subgroup of index two is normal.
proof: 若所有共轭元素都留在 N，就有 gNg⁻¹⊆N。把 g 换成 g⁻¹，再共轭回去得到反向包含，所以相等。
Conjugate closure gives gNg⁻¹⊆N. Apply this with g⁻¹ and conjugate back to obtain the reverse inclusion.
若 [G:H]=2，对 g∈H，两边陪集都为 H。
If the index is two and g∈H, both cosets equal H.
对 g∉H，唯一另一个左陪集和唯一另一个右陪集都为 G∖H，因此 gH=Hg。
If g∉H, the unique other left and right cosets are both G∖H, so they agree.

title: 陪集为什么能够相乘
Why coset multiplication is well-defined
text: 用代表元定义运算必须证明：换代表元后结果仍是同一个陪集。正规性正是允许把中间的 N 移过 b 的条件。
An operation defined with representatives must be independent of their choices. Normality lets the subgroup factor move past b.
proof: 写 a′=an₁、b′=bn₂，其中 n₁,n₂∈N。
Write alternative representatives a′=an₁ and b′=bn₂.
a′b′=an₁bn₂=ab(b⁻¹n₁b)n₂。由正规性，括号内元素及其与 n₂ 的乘积都在 N。
Compute a′b′=ab(b⁻¹n₁b)n₂. Normality puts the parenthesized term and its product with n₂ in N.
因此 a′b′N=abN，运算良定义。
Hence a′b′N=abN, proving independence of representatives.
warning: 如果 N 不正规，这条代表元乘法公式会产生矛盾；“陪集集合”始终存在，但未必能按此方式成为群。
For a nonnormal subgroup the representative formula fails. The coset set still exists, but this formula does not make it a group.

title: 商群及其群公理
The quotient group
text: 正规子群 N 的全部陪集在上述运算下构成商群。商群把 N 中的所有元素视作同一个单位元。
Cosets of a normal subgroup form a group under the well-defined product. Every element of N becomes the same identity element.
proof: 封闭性由 ab∈G 得到。结合律来自 (ab)c=a(bc)。
Closure follows from ab∈G, and associativity is inherited from G.
N·aN=aN·N=aN，所以 N 是单位元；aN·a⁻¹N=N，反向亦然。
N is a two-sided identity and a⁻¹N is a two-sided inverse of aN.
有限群时，商群的阶就是陪集数 |G/N|=[G:N]=|G|/|N|。
For finite G, the quotient order is the number of cosets: |G|/|N|.

title: 两个重要商群
Two important quotients
entries.tex: \mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z\cong C_n,\qquad D_3/\langle r\rangle\cong C_2
text: 整数模 n 是最熟悉的商群。三角形对称群模旋转子群后，只剩“保持方向”与“反转方向”两种类型。
Integers modulo n form the familiar quotient. Quotienting the triangle group by rotations leaves only orientation-preserving and orientation-reversing types.
example: 在 D₃/⟨r⟩ 中，任何两个反射所在的陪集相乘都是旋转陪集。商群的一个元素是一整个陪集，不能与某个固定代表混同。
In D₃/⟨r⟩, the product of two reflection cosets is the rotation coset. A quotient element is an entire coset, not a chosen representative.

title: 为什么正规性是必要的
Why normality is necessary
text: 若在左陪集集合上，代表元乘法对所有代表选择都良定义，则 H 必正规。由此，正规性既充分又必要。
If the representative product on left cosets is well-defined for every representative choice, H must be normal. Thus normality is both necessary and sufficient.
proof: 取 h∈H、g∈G。由于 hH=eH，把它们分别与 gH 相乘，良定义性给出 hgH=gH。
For h∈H, hH=eH. Multiplying by gH gives hgH=gH.
用左陪集相等判别，得到 g⁻¹hg∈H。对所有 g,h 成立，故 H 正规。
The coset criterion yields g⁻¹hg∈H for all g,h; hence H is normal.

question: 哪一种子群一定正规？
Which subgroup is necessarily normal?
reason: 指数 2 时，群外的唯一陪集同时是 G∖H，因此左右陪集相同。
At index two, the only nontrivial left and right cosets both equal G∖H.

question: D₃/⟨r⟩ 的阶是多少？
What is the order of D₃/⟨r⟩?
reason: 旋转子群有 3 个元素，所以商群阶为 6/3=2。
The rotation subgroup has order three, so the quotient has order two.

question: 商群 G/N 的单位元是什么？
What is the identity of G/N?
reason: 商群的元素是陪集；单位陪集是 eN=N。
Quotient elements are cosets; the identity is eN=N.

question: 为何在定义 (aN)(bN)=abN 时需要正规性？
Why is normality needed for (aN)(bN)=abN?
options: To make it independent of representatives
reason: 正规性使 b⁻¹n₁b 留在 N，从而换代表后仍得到 abN。
Normality puts b⁻¹n₁b in N, preserving the product coset.

question: 在 D₃ 中令 H={e,s}。用 eH=sH 展示陪集乘法并不良定义。
For H={e,s} in D₃, use eH=sH to show coset multiplication is ill-defined.
reason: 分别与 rH 相乘，代表 e 给出 rH={r,rs}；代表 s 给出 srH={r²s,r²}，二者不同。
Multiply by rH. Representative e gives {r,rs}, while representative s gives {r²s,r²}; these are different cosets.
